categories.name: Technology and Core Infrastructure
categories.blurb: What AI is built from: the models themselves, the silicon and datacenters they run on, the APIs and datasets that feed them, and the languages, frameworks, agents, and protocols developers use to build with them.

categories.name: Ecosystem Entities, Market and Operations
categories.blurb: Who is doing the work and what the market is doing: companies, people, funding, jobs, news, the historical timeline, and live telemetry on the health of the field.

categories.name: Research, Knowledge and Learning
categories.blurb: How the field explains itself: papers and their venues, books, courses and certifications, the skills graph, the glossary and taxonomy, and the media record of talks and podcasts.

categories.name: Enterprise Applications, Governance and Tools
categories.blurb: What organisations actually do with AI and the rules that constrain it: industry use cases, security, law and compliance, litigation, prompt libraries, benchmarks, calculators, and downloadable working documents.

categories.name: AI News
categories.blurb: Daily AI news from the publishers who broke it, split into headline coverage of the field and vendor announcements from the companies building it. Every story links to the original source, and any claim quoted in our coverage is cross-referenced against the laws, lawsuits, companies, tools, papers, and people already tracked in this atlas.
